import sys

def solve():
    input_line = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip('\n')
    c = list(input_line)
    l = 0
    r = 0
    ans = 0
    n = len(c)
    while l < n:
        r = l
        while r < n and c[r] == c[l]:
            r += 1
        if (r - l) % 2 == 0:
            ans += 1
        l = r
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
